papers.title: Effect of manufacturing parameters on mechanical properties of 316L stainless steel parts fabricated by selective laser melting: A computational framework
papers.first_author_affiliation: Mechanical, Industrial and Manufacturing Engineering Department, The University of Toledo, OH 43606, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Mohammad Elahinia
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Mechanical, Industrial and Manufacturing Engineering Department, The University of Toledo, OH 43606, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文虽涉及增材制造力学性能，但未聚焦生物医学植入物或应力屏蔽问题。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure for stress shielding, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对316L不锈钢力学性能的影响规律。
summary_zh.method: 建立结合有限元模拟与实验验证的计算框架来分析参数效应。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了工艺参数与力学性能之间的定量关系。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实际打印件的力学测试验证了计算模型的准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the influence of selective laser melting process parameters on the mechanical properties of 316L stainless steel parts.
summary_en.method: A computational framework combining finite element modeling and experimental validation was developed to analyze the effect of parameters.
summary_en.result: Quantitative relationships between process parameters and mechanical properties were established.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing of fabricated parts validated the computational predictions.

papers.title: Properties Evaluation of a Ti–6Al–4V Alloy Scaffold Fabricated by Electron Beam Melting and Selective Laser Melting for Bone Tissue Engineering
papers.venue: Journal of Biomaterials and Tissue Engineering

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接涉及Ti-6Al-4V多孔支架的EBM和SLM制造及性能，但未明确讨论应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper compares EBM and SLM scaffolds but does not include fatigue testing, osseointegration assessment, or explicit stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较EBM和SLM制造的Ti-6Al-4V多孔支架性能，用于骨组织工程。
summary_zh.method: 分别用EBM和SLM制备Ti-6Al-4V多孔支架，并进行力学性能表征。
summary_zh.result: 两种工艺支架力学性能差异显著，SLM支架强度更高但延性较低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩测试和微观形貌观察验证支架力学及结构性能。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the mechanical and structural properties of Ti-6Al-4V porous scaffolds fabricated by electron beam melting and selective laser melting for bone tissue engineering applications.
summary_en.method: Scaffolds with identical designed porosity were fabricated using both EBM and SLM, then characterized for mechanical properties and microstructure.
summary_en.result: SLM scaffolds exhibited higher compressive strength and stiffness but lower ductility compared to EBM scaffolds, attributed to differences in process-induced microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (compression) and scanning electron microscopy were used to validate the scaffold properties.

papers.title: Bioink properties before, during and after 3D bioprinting.
papers.abstract: Bioprinting is a process based on additive manufacturing from materials containing living cells. These materials, often referred to as bioink, are based on cytocompatible hydrogel precursor formulations, which gel in a manner compatible with different bioprinting approaches. The bioink properties before, during and after gelation are essential for its printability, comprising such features as achievable structural resolution, shape fidelity and cell survival. However, it is the final properties of the matured bioprinted tissue construct that are crucial for the end application. During tissue formation these properties are influenced by the amount of cells present in the construct, their proliferation, migration and interaction with the material. A calibrated computational framework is able to predict the tissue development and maturation and to optimize the bioprinting input parameters such as the starting material, the initial cell loading and the construct geometry. In this contribution relevant bioink properties are reviewed and discussed on the example of most popular bioprinting approaches. The effect of cells on hydrogel processing and vice versa is highlighted. Furthermore, numerical approaches were reviewed and implemented for depicting the cellular mechanics within the hydrogel as well as for prediction of mechanical properties to achieve the desired hydrogel construct considering cell density, distribution and material-cell interaction.
papers.first_author_affiliation: Institute of Materials Science and Technology, Technical University Vienna, Austria. Austrian Cluster for Tissue Regeneration, Austria.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了生物墨水的性质，但未涉及AI在生物打印中的应用，仅作为背景参考。
llm.why_not_core: No AI/ML integration into bioprinting workflow stages, no experimental validation of an AI model, and lacks advancement towards autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述生物打印中生物墨水在打印前、中、后的关键性质及计算预测方法。
summary_zh.method: 回顾并讨论不同生物打印方法下生物墨水的可打印性、凝胶化及细胞影响。
summary_zh.result: 指出校准的计算框架可预测组织发育并优化打印参数。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述与数值方法讨论。

summary_en.motivation: To review the essential properties of bioink before, during, and after 3D bioprinting and discuss computational approaches for predicting tissue maturation.
summary_en.method: The paper surveys bioink properties across different bioprinting techniques and implements numerical models of cellular mechanics and mechanical property prediction.
summary_en.result: A calibrated computational framework is proposed to predict tissue development and optimize bioprinting input parameters such as material, cell loading, and geometry.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the work is a review with numerical implementation examples.
